key_reasoning.reason: Entire fix was 2 prop additions (clickable: true, globalCloseEvents: { escape: true }) to the existing setupGlobalTooltip() function in src/utils/tooltip.ts. No Tooltip.tsx component changes, no ChatHeaderDownloadConversationButton changes, no consumer modifications. Bumped XS→S by red flag for touching a core shared utility.

Standard react-tooltip v5 props applied to an established singleton pattern. Zero security or performance implications. Trivially reversible — remove 2 props. The initial estimate overestimated risk due to API version uncertainty that resolved as straightforward v5 usage.
